svg.title: UML component diagram of the WAMD Electronics Store
svg.desc: main.jsx wraps App in a Redux Provider. App renders Header, ProductCard and Cart, which all use the cartSlice in the Redux store. App reads the products array.

g.text: state.cart.items: id, name, price, image, quantity

svg.text: Solid arrow: renders, reads or uses. Dashed arrow: Provider gives App the store.
